code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low O2 saturation/PaO2), mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, CRP, and total bilirubin, and increased RDW and basophils. These findings suggest acute respiratory failure with systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and risk of coagulopathy. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are recommended.
